actions.action: Lift inner pot out and pour away water in outer pot
Push finger 5 cm into soil to check moisture
If dry, water slowly until it drains, let drain, put back
If wet, wait until top 2-3 cm dries before watering
Ongoing: water when top 2-3 cm is dry (about weekly) and empty outer pot
Move plant about 1 m from bright window, out of hot afternoon sun
Cut mostly yellow fronds off at the base
Snip brown tips at an angle leaving thin brown line
Use filtered water or rainwater for watering
After a month, feed monthly in spring/summer with half-strength palm fertilizer

reason: The answer names low light only as an aggravating factor to adjustment stress rather than the main cause, but its fix list clearly includes moving the palm closer to the window, and nothing recommended is harmful.
